question: How many times was a Twitter/X post cited as a reference on the english Wikipedia pages for each day of August in the last June 2023 versions of the pages?

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Task received. Goal: count Twitter/X post citations used as references on English Wikipedia pages for each August day (August 1–31), specifically the last June 2023 revision of each. Team: WebSurfer (browser/API), FileSurfer (local files), Assistant (compilation). Plan: 1) Enumerate pages (August 1..31). 2) For each, get the last June 2023 revision ID. 3) Retrieve page content for that revision and scan references for twitter.com/x.com. 4) Summarize total count. Start with a few spot checks, then scale.

Visible relevant entries include: August 1, August 2, August 3, …, August 31. There are also non-day pages (e.g., August (given name), August (month)), but the 31 day pages are present as standalone articles.

mistake_reason: At step 8, the orchestrator treated a single twitter.com entry from the API's externallinks (which was explicitly truncated and not scoped to references) as definitive evidence of one Twitter/X reference and generalized across all August pages. They did not request clarification or full results despite the API indicating continuation, nor did they verify whether externallinks entries were actually used in the references section. This aligns with FM-2.2 (Fail to Ask for Clarification) by proceeding on incomplete and ambiguous data without seeking necessary confirmation.
